releaseNotes: Daily Driver Essentials plus v0.14.5 updater lock fix: updater runs outside the install directory, backs up by copy instead of moving the live app folder, replaces files in place with retry handling, preserves rollback, and retains visible/native window motion, audio-safe Memory Saver, bookmarks, downloads, find, zoom, print, startup controls, default-browser groundwork, and local D2L / Brightspace assignment reminders.
